headline_marked: Trump warns Iran: [[1000 missiles ready]] if you try to kill me
headline: Trump warns Iran: 1000 missiles ready if you try to kill me
summary: Former US President Donald Trump has threatened Iran with a massive missile strike, stating that thousands of missiles are prepared to be launched if Iran attempts to assassinate him.
details: Former US President Donald Trump has issued a stark warning to Iran, threatening to unleash thousands of missiles if the country attempts to assassinate him. Trump made the threat on his social media platform, Truth Social, stating that Iran's government is issuing threats globally against the current US President.

Trump elaborated on his threat, saying, "If Iran takes any action to harm the United States—or, as has been reported, another assassination attempt against me—Iran will be hit with an atomic power, a power the likes of which has never been seen before in history."

He further stated that "a thousand missiles have been aimed at Iran and are ready to fire," adding that "more will follow." Trump asserted that the US military is prepared, willing, and able, and that the duration of their readiness can be extended if necessary. He vowed that the US forces would completely obliterate and destroy all Iranian territories.

This threat comes in the wake of a CNN report, citing Israeli intelligence shared with the US, suggesting that Iran has recently formulated a new plan to assassinate President Trump. Two sources familiar with the matter confirmed this to CNN.

The intelligence sharing has added another layer of tension between the US and Iran amidst ongoing negotiations for a ceasefire. A source indicated that this warning was issued earlier in the week, while another mentioned that the US had been receiving consistent intelligence about potential assassination plots against Trump for several weeks.

However, some US officials have suggested a different interpretation, proposing that Israel might have strategically released this information to influence Trump's decision on whether to escalate military actions against Iran.

The context for these threats includes past events, such as the US drone strike ordered by Trump in 2020 that killed Iran's top general, Qasem Soleimani. The US government has long warned that Iran might seek retribution by attempting to assassinate Trump.

Additionally, recent reports indicate that Iran's Supreme Leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, was killed in a recent Iran-Israel conflict involving US strikes. His funeral ceremonies, which lasted a week, drew massive crowds. During these mourning processions, slogans calling for Trump's assassination and banners were displayed, intensifying fears that Iran might retaliate against Trump.

headline_marked: PM Tarique attends [[Dhaka Medical College's 80th anniversary]]
headline: PM Tarique attends Dhaka Medical College's 80th anniversary
summary: The Prime Minister inaugurated the celebrations, laid the foundation for new female hostels, and participated in a discussion on modernizing the health system.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman arrived at the Dhaka Medical College (DMC) campus on Saturday morning to celebrate the institution's 80th anniversary.
The Prime Minister inaugurated the event by releasing balloons and pigeons, creating a festive atmosphere across the campus and surrounding areas.
As part of the Health Education Directorate's 20-hostel project, the Prime Minister laid the foundation stones for two new female hostels at DMC.
The event included a tree-planting program, which the Prime Minister inaugurated by planting a tree on the lawn adjacent to the Shaheed Dr. Milon Auditorium.
Prime Minister Tarique Rahman also participated in an open discussion titled 'DMCians' Thoughts on Modernizing Bangladesh's Health System.'
During the discussion, the Prime Minister is expected to announce several new projects related to the health sector.
The Prime Minister was accompanied by his wife, Dr. Zobaida Rahman, a former student of Dhaka Medical College.
caption:
Celebrating 80 years of medical excellence! PM Tarique Rahman visits Dhaka Medical College to modernize the health system.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman arrived at the Dhaka Medical College (DMC) campus on Saturday morning to celebrate the institution's 80th anniversary.

The Prime Minister inaugurated the event by releasing balloons and pigeons, creating a festive atmosphere across the campus and surrounding areas.

As part of the Health Education Directorate's 20-hostel project, the Prime Minister laid the foundation stones for two new female hostels at DMC.

The event included a tree-planting program, which the Prime Minister inaugurated by planting a tree on the lawn adjacent to the Shaheed Dr. Milon Auditorium.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman also participated in an open discussion titled 'DMCians' Thoughts on Modernizing Bangladesh's Health System.'

During the discussion, the Prime Minister is expected to announce several new projects related to the health sector.

The Prime Minister was accompanied by his wife, Dr. Zobaida Rahman, a former student of Dhaka Medical College.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, Somoy News, The Daily Star
